description: Accessibility audit of marketing or transactional email HTML. Pass the full source as `html`. Checks layout tables missing role=presentation, missing lang and title, images without alt or with decorative alt mistakes, image-only emails and likely text in images, vague link text such as "click here", font sizes under 14px, low-contrast inline colour pairs, missing preheader, fixed width over 600px, heading structure, color-scheme declaration, estimated tap-target height of table-built buttons, and reading-order risks in multi-column tables. Email clients differ and this reads markup only: it does not render the email, resolve <style> classes for colour, or confirm a plain-text alternative. Each finding names the WCAG criterion and a fix.

html.description: The full HTML source of the email.

name: audit_email_accessibility
title: Email accessibility audit
